googleReviews: I admit that I found out about this Norfolk Virginia Makers Craft and Brewery location after hearing about it referenced via people at my current place of employment. I took a chance with going there less than 8 hours ago.  I tried a black cherry shandy which was delicious and the employee helping me to select the order was highly polite. It was tempting to order another beer. However I felt myself get a light buzz after just one drink and I chose to voluntarily restrain myself tonight for personal reasons. There was a Rosa's Lumpia truck outside of the restaurant and I chose to order 4 pieces of lumpia which I received with sweet chili sauce which was also delicious and luckily that food helped to soak up the beer I was enjoying. The employees handling my food order were friendly and cheerful towards me even with I being slightly buzzed. Obviously I intend to keep an open mind to returning and I am glad to have tried some of the beer with some lumpia on the side.
